compiled_state.title: As a ui-designer committee, I want a 5th visual-spatial-evaluator reviewer owning pixel-observable legibility with documented arbitration and fallback, so pixel vs intent concerns are scored by the right judge and merged deterministically

comments.body:
## Description

**What**: Create the visual-spatial-evaluator committee reviewer, update design-systems-lead to split visual_hierarchy, and document arbitration with fallback for when the 5th reviewer is absent.

**Scope**:
- IN: plugins/dso/skills/ui-designer/docs/reviewers/visual-spatial-evaluator.md
- IN: Modify plugins/dso/skills/ui-designer/docs/reviewers/design-systems-lead.md — remove legacy visual_hierarchy, add visual_hierarchy_intent
- IN: plugins/dso/skills/ui-designer/docs/arbitration.md with tie-break rules
- IN: 5-reviewer fixture regression + 4-reviewer-fallback fixture test
- OUT: Post-batch dispatch wiring (draft-5a)

## Done Definitions

- When this story is complete, visual-spatial-evaluator.md exists, emits JSON at same path/key shape as existing 4 reviewers; owns visual_hierarchy_legibility (pixel-observable)
  <- Satisfies: sc-5
- When this story is complete, design-systems-lead.md no longer emits visual_hierarchy; emits only visual_hierarchy_intent (text reasoning); legacy dimension absent from output; regression asserts absence
  <- Satisfies: sc-5
- When this story is complete, arbitration.md documents: pixel-observable conflicts → visual_hierarchy_legibility wins; intent-only conflicts → visual_hierarchy_intent wins; 3-2 tie definition; 2-2-abstain definition; tie-break with critical findings override
  <- Satisfies: sc-5
- When this story is complete, 4-reviewer fallback (when draft-5a hard-stop skips 5th reviewer): 4-reviewer majority + tie defaults to block; fixture test covers this path
  <- Satisfies: sc-5
- When this story is complete, 5-reviewer fixture produces combined verdict from all 5 reviewers; arbitration produces deterministic merged verdict; visual-spatial-evaluator verdict is structurally distinct from design-systems-lead
  <- Satisfies: sc-5
- When this story is complete, unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue. Escalate only when genuinely blocked. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
